card.name: Ampersand in DOSAGE & ADMINISTRATION
card.fires_on: Mainly the ampersand in the section heading "DOSAGE & ADMINISTRATION". Also adjective-like words right after "The recommended" such as total or treatment, before duration or schedule.

modes.label: Heading ampersand
modes.description: The & between DOSAGE and ADMINISTRATION in the section title of a drug label.

modes.label: After 'The recommended'
modes.description: A noun modifier following 'The recommended' that leads into duration or schedule wording.
modes.example: The recommended<< treatment>> schedule is as follows: Weeks 1

card.plain: It lights up on the & in the dosage and administration heading of a drug label, and weakly on words after 'The recommended'.
